standard_prerequisites.use: Closes the unit-point argument for decent spaces.

standard_prerequisites.name: Diagonal of a groupoid
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Groupoids in Spaces, lemma diagonal (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: j = (t, s) separated once the stabilizer is separated.

core_obligations: Prove the group case: reduce to e : S -> G closed immersion and conclude from the decent-spaces lemma.
Prove the groupoid case: replace B by S, invoke separatedness of the stabilizer, apply the diagonal lemma, and use that U x_S U is affine over a field.
Conclude R separated via the separated-over-separated base lemma.
proof_roadmap: Two reductions: unit-closedness for G, then diagonal separability for R over an affine base.
difficulty_reason: Two assertions with different reductions; the field-affine observation and the diagonal transfer are real steps.
